skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo of 45% ATK (+5) DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 22% ATK (+2) DMG to each enemy in the entire row. Each hit has a 50% chance to deal an additional 10% ATK extra DMG.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo of 22% ATK (+2) DMG to each enemy in the entire row. Each hit has a 50% chance to deal an additional 20% ATK extra DMG.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains (+20) HP. On the first turn, if Hellish Blizzard is present, increases DMG dealt by 20%, lasting until the end of battle.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains (+20) HP. On the first turn, if Hellish Blizzard is present, increases DMG dealt by 30%, lasting until the end of battle.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently gains (+20) HP. On the first turn, if Hellish Blizzard is present, increases DMG dealt by 35%, lasting until the end of battle.
